neighbours.label: the slot just before a colour word in a description of colour or change of colour (teeth becoming whiter, red to the darkest purple)
fire: Since she started the treatment, her teeth have been becoming whiter every week.
As the meat is heated under pressure, it ends up becoming pink in the middle.
The berries range in colour from the brightest red to the darkest purple.
This bird is small and pale in the north, larger and less pale in the south.
After the bleach, the old shirt was turning whiter with each wash.
In autumn the maple leaves change from green to a deep, burning orange.
The paint dried and the wall looked so much brighter and whiter than before.
Over the years the copper roof slowly became green with a dull patina.
quiet: Since she started the treatment, her teeth have been becoming stronger every week.
As the meat is heated under pressure, it ends up becoming tender in the middle.
The berries range in size from the smallest pea to the largest plum.
This bird is small and shy in the north, larger and less shy in the south.
After the repair, the old shirt was lasting longer with each wash.
In autumn the maple leaves change from soft to dry and brittle.
The paint dried and the wall looked so much smoother and cleaner than before.
Over the years the copper roof slowly became thin with small holes.

notes: Logit effect promotes ' wh', ' bl'; top examples precede white/pink/purple/pale.
